text:
tom: Pinging this thread to capture the bridge design follow-up for precision profiles. Need final list of runtime responsibilities.

anya: Bridge should be minimal: profile selection, device-capability probe, fallback ordering, and telemetry tagging. No customer API breaks.

kevin: Note: FP8 and INT8 fail in different ways (bias vs entropy loss). Bridge must record metrics that let us distinguish.

maria: Agreed. Telemetry fields: model_id, precision_used, fallback_reason, degradation_score, latency_delta, token_count.

luke: Ops: fallback order must consider GPU kernel quality. Device probe at startup, cache per node.

tom: How do we handle KV cache when switching precisions?

anya: Invalidate cache on precision switch and warm with shadow requests. Also mark TTL to avoid frequent churn.

kevin: Add a hysteresis window: require N requests or M seconds stable before switching back.

maria: Docs: will add migration guide and explain degradation_score semantics + sample alerts.

luke: SDK change: add precision_preference client option (nullable). Server honors but applies auto-fallback unless enterprise flag disables it.

ops-bot: CI report: shadow tests pass on A100, marginal on V100/T4. See /ci/quant/1310.

kevin: For older cards tighten thresholds or use GPU-profile whitelist. I'll add per-gpu heuristics.

tom: Policy: allow force_precision with admin opt-in and logged fallback telemetry.

anya: Agree. Force should require explicit warning and retention of fallback traces.

maria: Rollout plan: 1) bridge core + probe (2w), 2) shadow on select endpoints (1w), 3) canary customers + docs (2w), 4) full enable + shim removal (4w). Parallelize SDK/docs/telemetry.

kevin: I'll own bridge core and probe. Luke owns SDK. Maria docs. Tom owns rollout and comms.

ops-bot: Action created: epic quant-bridge-52, canary tag quant-bridge/canary added.
